journal.title: Learning, building and sharing.
journal.description: Short technical reflections from my work in backend development, interactive web experiences and applied AI.

django.title: Why Django Remains Central to My Work
django.summary: How Django connects application logic, data models and maintainable backend development.
django.content: Django brings together routing, data models, authentication and application structure. I particularly value how it supports content-rich applications alongside Wagtail. As I explore AI-powered software, Django continues to provide a practical foundation for building the services around language models.

three.title: Building Interactive Experiences with Three.js
three.summary: Exploring procedural geometry, animations and interaction in a React portfolio.
three.content: For this portfolio, I use React Three Fiber to create 3D objects inside React components. The engineering challenge is not simply making objects move: it is connecting scene interaction to application state, preserving mobile usability and keeping navigation accessible without a 3D interface.

ai.title: From Django Applications to AI-Powered Systems
ai.summary: How existing backend engineering skills provide a foundation for applied AI.
ai.content: My Django AI Employees project is a place to explore customer support workflows, orders and conversations. The next development stages involve connecting language models, introducing controlled tool use and evaluating system behaviour. I am approaching these as engineering problems that require dependable application design, not just prompting.
